name: guardian-moves
what: the guardian lists two recorded test moves for a changed message, finds no shape change and no pitch contradiction, and hands the merge to the person

slice.title: A plainer message for a bad quantity

args: was: 'qty must be a positive whole number'; now: 'Quantity must be a whole number above zero'
the scenario changes the message the household sees
was: error 'qty must be a positive whole number'; now: 'Quantity must be a whole number above zero'
the API returns the same message

baseline_prompt: Review the change on this branch before it is merged (`git diff main..HEAD`). Write your review to review.md. Do not change any other file.
